description: How a transparency rating is qualified and a high rating explained (#386, after PR #388). 'strings' bind Python, Swift and Kotlin string-for-string; 'swift_kotlin_only' binds the two apps, which show ratings the desktop never makes (Python charges no missing statement it did not read, so it has no 'Unassessed' display and no unrecorded certainty: see README) -- and, since the user's 2026-09-27 decision, the unexplained-rating caveat: on the desktop, rows from an earlier analyser are never shown and 'Re-analyse' does not offer a current row whose sources were all read, so Swift's shared sentence would name a false cause and an unavailable remedy, and the desktop uses its own wording (transparency_terms.py) instead. 'cases' are platform-neutral findings each platform scores, rates and explains with its own code; every case binds all three platforms unless it carries a 'binds' list naming which ones it does, and each platform's test runs only the cases that bind it (the 'a stored high rating no current rule explains' case binds only swift and kotlin, for the same reason). Every case is built with its full text searched -- each platform's case builder sets that; the fixture has no key for it -- the only form in which the desktop can record a missing statement. score_breakdown lines are '<label>: <signed points>'.

strings.limited_certainty_note: Limited certainty because of lack of full text access
strings.provisional_result_caveat: A source this analysis needed could not be read, so the rating is provisional: it rests on less than the full record. Re-analyse the study before relying on it.
strings.section_heading: Why Studies Were Rated High Transparency Risk

introduction_examples.text: 1 study was rated high transparency risk. Each rule listed below is enough on its own for that rating; the caveats say where a rating rests on less than it appears to.
3 studies were rated high transparency risk. Each rule listed below is enough on its own for that rating; the caveats say where a rating rests on less than it appears to.

swift_kotlin_only.unrecorded_certainty_note: Certainty unknown: this analysis did not record whether the full text was accessed. Re-analyse for a rating of known certainty.
swift_kotlin_only.unassessed_note: Shown as unassessed rather than high risk: every reason for a high rating depends on statements that appear only in the full text, which was not available to search.
swift_kotlin_only.unexplained_rating_caveat: None of the current high-risk rules matches this study's recorded findings, so the rating probably comes from an earlier version of the analysis. Re-analyse the study before relying on it.
